'''March 2001 Illinois tournament (28 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament on 28 March 2001. [[Geoff Snider]] won it. It is known from Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1974">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-29-geoff-kicks-scrub-a-mercifullyd1974/ geoff-kicks-scrub-a-mercifully], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 29 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-29-geoff-kicks-scrub-a-mercifullyd1974/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 March 2001
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Geoff Snider]]
